items.q: Do most people resist group pressure to conform?
items.correct: No — studies show many people conform or obey authority.
items.misconception: Yes, most people stay fully independent.
items.why: Asch found high conformity; Milgram found strong obedience — situations powerfully shape behaviour.

items.q: What did Milgram's study show about obedience?
items.correct: Ordinary people often obey authority figures, even against their conscience.
items.misconception: Almost no one obeyed the experimenter.
items.random_wrong: People only obey if threatened with violence.
items.why: Around 65% delivered the maximum shock, showing situational pressure to obey authority.
